activities.description: Document all modules in use, customizations, integrations, user counts, and data volumes in the legacy CRM
Measure record counts for each object type. Account, Contact, Visit/Call, Sample Transaction, Order, Event, Content are the primary volume drivers
Map all applicable regulations (PDMA, Sunshine Act, GDPR, country-specific) to platform capabilities and migration requirements
Identify all stakeholders: IT, Commercial Operations, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Compliance, Legal, Field Sales, Regional leads
Document all systems integrated with legacy CRM: ERP, MDM, BI, compliance reporting, content management, signature capture, email service providers
Inventory all CLM/content assets. Classify as: migrate-as-is (PDF), needs conversion (HTML with proprietary JS), retire (unused >12 months)
Design the target data model. Map every legacy object to its target equivalent. Identify gaps requiring custom objects or fields
Design the target security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, sharing rules, territory-based access
Design all integration patterns: ERP sync, MDM feed, BI pipeline, compliance reporting. Define APIs, frequencies, error handling
Define the migration approach: big-bang vs. phased, data cutover plan, parallel run period, rollback strategy
Design the target territory hierarchy. Flat (matching legacy) vs. hierarchical (leveraging platform capabilities). Phase 1 usually mirrors legacy
Define mobile app configuration, offline data sets, sync behavior, conflict resolution rules
Design the consent management model. Map legacy consent records to Individual + ContactPointConsent. Configure country-specific defaults
Configure the target platform: custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, picklist values, validation rules, workflows
Build and deploy profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, sharing rules, territory assignments
Build ETL scripts for each data object. Include transformation logic, validation, error handling, and rollback capability
Build integration middleware connecting target platform to ERP, MDM, BI, and other systems. Test each integration independently
Migrate PDF content as-is. Convert or rebuild HTML content that used proprietary APIs. Retire unused content
deliverables: MLR review queue for rebuilt content

activities.description: Rebuild the top 20-30 most-used reports and dashboards from legacy system. Validate data accuracy against legacy reports
Configure mobile data sets, sync rules, offline capabilities, and field-level mobile visibility
Extract data from legacy system. Cleanse: deduplicate accounts, standardize addresses, normalize picklist values, remove orphaned records
Load a representative subset (10-20%) into a sandbox. Validate referential integrity, field mapping accuracy, and data quality
Full-volume trial migration into a sandbox. Measure load times, validate all objects, test integrations end-to-end
Run all validation rules: referential integrity, sample audit trail, consent defaults, visit-account associations, user permissions
Execute production data migration during the cutover window. Follow the documented load order: Reference Data → Accounts → Users → Visits → Samples → Orders → Events → Consent → Coaching
Test all integrations end-to-end: ERP order flow, MDM account updates, BI data pipeline, compliance reporting
Business users test every key workflow: visit creation, sample drops, order entry, event management, content presentation, reporting
Test mobile workflows in both online and offline modes. Validate sync behavior, conflict resolution, and data completeness
Validate all regulatory requirements are met: sample audit trail, transparency reporting, consent management, electronic records
Load test with expected concurrent users. Measure page load times, sync times, report generation times, API response times
Run both legacy and target systems simultaneously for 2-4 weeks. Compare outputs: reports, compliance data, inventory balances
Executive review of all test results, outstanding defects, risk assessment. Formal go/no-go decision with documented criteria
Load any data changes that occurred between the full migration and cutover. Validate delta load completeness
Disable write access to legacy system. Redirect all users to the new platform. Keep legacy in read-only mode for reference period
Verify every user role can log in, see their data, and complete their primary workflow within the first 2 hours of go-live
Provide enhanced support for 2-4 weeks post go-live. War room staffing, escalation paths, rapid response team for critical issues
Track user adoption metrics: login frequency, feature usage, mobile adoption, report usage. Identify low-adoption areas for targeted training
After hypercare period and data validation, formally decommission the legacy system. Archive data per retention policy
Implement features that were deferred from the initial migration: hierarchical territories, advanced analytics, AI-driven insights
